news.title: Mukka Proteins Limited (NSEI:MUKKA) completed the acquisition of remaining 25.99% stake in Ento Proteins Private Limited from Holocene Ecosolutions Private Limited.
news.body:
Mukka Proteins Limited (NSEI:MUKKA) signed a letter of intent to acquire remaining 25.99% stake in Ento Proteins Private Limited from Holocene Ecosolutions Private Limited for INR 3.2 million on February 12, 2026. Mukka Proteins Limited entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire remaining 25.99% stake in Ento Proteins Private Limited from Holocene Ecosolutions Private Limited on February 12, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 3.2 million will be paid by Mukka Proteins Limited. As part of consideration, INR 3.2 million is paid towards common equity of Ento Proteins Private Limited. Upon completion, Mukka Proteins Limited will own 100% stake in Ento Proteins Private Limited.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 3.1% Last year net profit margin: 6.8% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (3.0x net interest cover). news.title: Mukka Proteins Limited (NSEI:MUKKA) agreed to acquire remaining 2% stake in Haris Marine Products Private Limited for INR 2 million.
news.body:
Mukka Proteins Limited (NSEI:MUKKA) agreed to acquire remaining 2% stake in Haris Marine Products Private Limited for INR 2 million on February 12, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 1.96 million will be paid by Mukka Proteins Limited. Upon completion, Mukka Proteins Limited will own 100% stake in Haris Marine Products Private Limited. For the period ending March 31, 2025, Haris Marine Products Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 0 and net income of INR 22.4 million.

The transaction has been approved by the board of directors of Mukka Proteins Limited. The transaction is expected to close on June 30, 2026.

news.body:
Mukka Proteins Limited (NSEI:MUKKA) entered into a Share Transfer Agreement to acquire 68% stake in United Gulf Fishery Products LLC from Saif Salim Ahmed Al-Rawahi for OMR 0.03 million on December 10, 2025. Mukka Proteins Limited acquire 34,000 shares of OMR 1 each for a total consideration of OMR 0.03 million.

The completion of acquisition is subject to compliance of Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) Regulations, 2022 or such other Regulations as may be notified by the Reserve Bank of India.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.20 (vs ₹0.07 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.20 (up from ₹0.07 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.51b (up 68% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹58.8m (up 183% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.3% (up from 1.4% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.
